title: iria junciformis
intro: Iria junciformis, commonly known as Iria, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its leaves and roots being the primary sources of its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Iria junciformis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Iria junciformis include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
